svg.aria-label: Key signatures of B flat, F, C, G and D major in treble clef, each with its tonic and relative minor
svg.text: Grade 2 keys: read the key from the signature
Treble clef. Blue note = the major tonic. Red note = its relative minor: same signature, 3 semitones lower.
Left to right: 2 flats, 1 flat, none, 1 sharp, 2 sharps. Brown accidental = the one the rule reads.
